details: Architected a GPT-4o Vision collateral-valuation system that identifies trading cards from photos, checks authenticity and quality, estimates market value, and recommends risk-aware loan terms.

Shipped FastAPI production pipelines for vision preprocessing, prompt engineering, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop admin review, wired into AWS S3, PostgreSQL, and underwriting so appraisals finish faster with less manual work.

Built a vision-action agent for SCORM/Articulate 360 that screenshots the canvas player, reasons with a multimodal LLM, and drives CDP mouse/keyboard actions when DOM agents miss the real click target.

Designed an agent-memory layer that fingerprints slides, stores success/failure traces as prior-experience hints, and an LLM pipeline that turns long documents into structured prompt clusters and reviewable course content.
Built an analysis-ready data layer across all 50 US states by collecting, cleaning, and transforming messy multi-dimensional datasets into consistent, comparable records.
Designed REST APIs and a LangChain chatbot with embeddings so users could ask contextual questions instead of digging through raw files.
Automated large-scale web scraping, validation, and Google Drive upload so new datasets reached storage without a manual collection loop.
